Strategy: Refine the distribution family with a same-size peak: score bins by closeness of the leftover to the item size, so the chosen bin can take one more item, with a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin leaves less than one item while a looser bin leaves one item. Reserving one-item spaces may pair equal items, but it can waste tight fits when they never arrive.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - abs((r - item) - item) for r in bins]
```
